annotations.title: One credit provider or BDC in full

description: A credit manager or a BDC: classes, advised BDCs from each 10-K, quarterly portfolio (fair value, principal, borrowers, marks, PIK), largest facilities and sponsors financed. Accepts a private credit id or a BDC's CIK. detail=compact returns key facts under 2 KB. Without a paid plan on a vertical, lists name their first 5 rows and count the rest; each answer states what it withheld.

detail.description: compact: the id, name, type, up to five key facts with their citation and counts of the related rows by type, under 2 KB. research (the default): the full answer.

dfx_id.description: A DFX id of the form dfx:<graph>:<id> (fo, isi, vc, pe, ria, al, pc, ref), or a bare real estate id.
